title: feat(fields): RecordPickerDialog UI/UX overhaul — skeleton loading, sticky header, page jump, enhanced styling
body:
The lookup field record picker dialog had significant usability and visual gaps compared to mainstream low-code platforms. This overhaul addresses the core UX pain points. ### Skeleton loading - Replaced the plain "Loading…" spinner with a table-shaped skeleton screen that mirrors the actual column layout during initial fetch. - Subsequent fetches (page/sort/filter) render a semi-transparent overlay with spinner over existing data instead of replacing it. ### Sticky table header - `` is now `sticky top-0` so column labels stay visible during vertical scroll. ### Page jump - Added an input field in the pagination bar — type a page number and press Enter to navigate directly. Invalid values are silently ignored. ### Table styling - Even/odd row striping (`bg-muted/20`), refined selected-row highlight (`bg-primary/5`), uppercase column headers with `tracking-wider`, rounded table border, tighter cell padding. - Row background logic extracted to `getRowBgClass` helper for readability. ### Search & filter area - Search bar wrapped in a `rounded-md border bg-muted/30` container with borderless input for cleaner visual separation from the filter bar. - Filter panel now supports `lg:grid-cols-3` on wide viewports. ### Responsive dialog sizing - Dialog uses responsive breakpoints (`sm:max-w-3xl lg:max-w-5xl`) to properly override the base `DialogContent`'s `sm:max-w-lg`, scaling from 768px on medium screens to 1024px on large screens for better data density. ### z-index discipline - z-index values use Tailwind utilities (`z-[5]`, `z-10`) per repo guidelines (no inline styles). ### Fix: React Error #185 (close-reset cycle) - Separated the dialog close-reset logic into its own `useEffect` (depends only on `open`) from the fetch-trigger effect (depends on `open` + pagination/sort/filter deps). Previously, the combined effect caused cascading state updates when closing — resetting `currentPage`/`sortField` changed the effect's own dependencies, re-triggering it in a loop that could hit React's maximum update depth. ### Storybook stories - Added `record-picker-dialog.stories.tsx` with Default, MultiSelect, and WithFilters stories using a mock DataSource with simulated latency for visual verification. ### Tests - 8 new tests covering skeleton column-count validation, sticky header classes, page jump (valid/invalid/single-page), and loading overlay. - Updated existing loading state test to match the new skeleton UI. ### Visual verification (Storybook) | Default (single-select, pagination, page jump) | Wide viewport (1440px) | |---|---| | | | > **Note**: Changes are in the `@object-ui/fields` package and will be visible in the console after this PR is merged and deployed. To verify locally, run `pnpm storybook` and navigate to **Fields → RecordPickerDialog**.
